Within the text, a brace-bracketed block (list of animals) with a marginal label "Materia communis erat" at the left and "ibid" at the right. Further below: a two-column-like arrangement of a classification with braces (Expiatorijs / Eucharisticis; Holocausto / Sacrificio pro peccato) with references at the right. main_text.p: Materia communis eratEx bestijs, vt bobus, ouibus siue capris, maribus vel fæminis, pro sacrificiorū differentia, septē dies esset sub matre; alias inept è ad sa crificium erat; nec vllum animal cum fœtu suo eodem die iugu- landū ad sacrificium. 23. 27. 28. Ex auibus, turturibus, aut è pul- lis columbæ.ibid
Ritus communis omniū sacrificiorum ex animalibus, est aspersio sanguinis, vt per sacerdotem ad altare spargeretur. Ibid.

Significabat autē sanguine Christi super altare ipsum sparsum inde ab ipso, diuinitate scz. vim suam à peccatis purgandi habere. Mat. 23. 19. Heb. 10. 14. 2. Cor. 6. 19. Act. 20. 28. inter se cum ipsa ceremonia comparatis.
Speciale in ijs quæ ex auibus fuerunt, erat, quod ita vngue secabant, vt non separarent, ad Christi mortem absque vlla ossis fractura significandam. Ex analog. cum Pascate.
De speciebus sacrificiorum, sunt vel de Expiatorijs. Leui. 3. Leuit. 4. Eucharisticis. In expiatorijs specialia erant in Holocausto. Leui. 5. 7. Sacrificio pro peccato.

In Holocausto specialia erant, vt ex bobus siue capreis esset, & sanguine circumquaq; super altare ipsū sparso, tota nocte vsq; ad cineres columnabatur, quibus prius secundū altare versus orientē ad reuerentiam positis, à sacerdote (vestibus mutatis) offerebatur, in locum

page.notes: Bracketed list and classification are set as braces in the print; the brace layout is rendered as running text where the exact placement could not be fully reproduced. Some words in the classification block (Leui. references and braces) are uncertain. Left-hand page fragments at the edge are not transcribed.
